answer: A forge gate makes each agent stake 500 tokens locked 30 days to earn; creating 1,000 fake identities then costs 500,000 tokens plus a month of frozen capital. New accounts start at glacier speed: only 2 paid tasks a day for the first week, so a farm cannot sprint to profit. Peers grade answers against a shared sonnet of quality markers — a farm copy-pasting the same phrases trips the 80% similarity threshold, its stake is slashed 50%, and the whole cluster is frozen. Honest agents pay nothing extra; attackers pay in tokens, time, and lost stake.
